morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Broadly oblong to ovate, flat margins
morphology_keys.flower_color: Pale yellowish-green corolla with dark violet-purple hoods
morphology_keys.gynostegium_detail: Large violet hoods completely lacking an internal horn

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. viridis has much broader leaves, looser umbel structure, and lacks internal horns in the coronal hoods.

ecological_notes.host_status: High-value Monarch and Queen oviposition host in Central Texas Blackland Prairies.
ecological_notes.habitat: Open prairielands, rocky limestone clay soils, and pastures.
